notes.title: Respawn. Reload. STHELL 2.5 is here!
notes.content:
:.A.:.L.:.E.:.R.:.T.:

This is an all-frequency priority broadcast to all field agents. STHELL is evolving in effort to even the playfield and give us a better chance in the desperate fight against the machine invaders. This is not a drill. This is the time to strike!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40667111/3e67c7e8fd0c659d8a2e396e8ffe624e4e661317.gif

The following permanent changes have been made to the STHELL field combat protocol:

.:..:..:FULL CHANGELOG:..:.:.
..::New features::..

 Perks are now permanent. This means, once you buy a perk, you keep it forever and you'll be able to equip/unequip it before each run. You'll still need to buy slots to equip them (unlocked slots are permanent too).
 Perks are now more expensive, for better balancing oft their new permanent nature.

..::Quality of life changes::..

 The Upgrades view has better icons and interact behavior for buy/equip/unequip perks
 The Machine Gun Turret has now a green indicator for better visibility and better understand when the ability expires
 Frame cap setting now offers 75 and 90 fps too

..::Bug fixes::..

 The two spawn platforms (Ammo box and Med box) have better colliders to avoid abrupt friction while running/dashing towards them
 Health points don't go negative anymore
 A couple of typos here and there


With this major update, your performance should improve. Or at least - alter. Any alteration can be the tipping point in this struggle against the relentless mechanical foe. Your mission remains the same. 

DESTROY THE MACHINES. SURVIVE STHELL.

BROADCAST:END.

notes.title: STHELL V2.0: Perks, Abilities & Community/Twitch Leaderboards!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
STHELL v2.0 is here! Some tasty features are coming with this major update.
Are you ready?


Upgrades. Every machine you kill now drops credits. Collect them and make a stash, then buy perks and abilities for your next run!
Upgrades Shop. Unlock up to 4 perks slots, buy new perks and abilities and customize your build.
Community Leaderboards. Create your own leaderboard and share the credentials with your followers/friends to have private matches.
New languages: Spanish, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Italian.
New fonts and new logo.
New settings: FOV slider, weapons autoswitch.
Minor fixes here and there.


We're looking forward to have your feedbacks!
Have fun and git gud.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40667111/8c3fe7ec19a9d7a1bb034d1ce9bd723af5220e4b.gif
